description: For a well-ordered linear order, a property holds everywhere if it holds at minimal points, passes from an immediate predecessor to its successor, and holds at limit points whenever it holds at all earlier points.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.three_case_induction.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] (P : α → Prop)
  (base : ∀ (a : α), IsMin a → P a) (step : ∀ (a b : α), a ⋖ b → P a → P b)
  (limit : ∀ (b : α), Order.IsSuccLimit b → (∀ a < b, P a) → P b) (a : α) : P a
